crossRefs.note: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

parallels.note: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

translations.web: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
translations.bsb: And he overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. He also overlaid the crossbars with gold.
translations.kjv: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
translations.asv: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold for places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
